inputs.script: Almost every business needs visual content: social posts, flyers, menus, and slides. Most small businesses cannot hire a designer, so there is real demand for people who can design well. You do not need to be a trained artist. Clients pay for clear, attractive, on-time results. In this course you will learn Canva, build a portfolio, and find your first clients. Expect your income to grow over several months, not overnight.
